 Courtesy of Netflix 
 The new year will start off with a bang as Netflix ’s Ginny & Georgia returns for its fourth season on January 21.
 For those needing a refresher, Georgia Miller (Brianne Howey) has dodged a murder charge by the end of Season 3, so her life should be back to normal. But longtime viewers know that life in the Miller family is never normal. Georgia is also pregnant, and she didn’t know who the father was at the end of Season 3, when her telltale sign of chugging milk straight from the carton hinted at the shocking news. Joe (Raymond Ablack) and Mayor Paul Randolph (Scott Porter) are among the top candidates for Baby Wellsbury’s parentage.

 “Strange things keep happening, hinting that maybe Georgia’s past isn’t willing to stay buried,” the Season 4 description reads. “Ginny is desparate to break the cycle of chaos, and Georgia is desperate to prove to her kids that she can. And as for Austin…well… This season it’s him against the world. The family is at a turning point.”
 Watch on Deadline 
 RELATED: 2026-27 Premiere Dates For New & Returning Series On Broadcast, Streaming & Cable 
 Ginny (Antonia Gentry) won a poetry contest last season after experiencing a surprise pregnancy of her own via Wolf (Ty Doran) and choosing to get an abortion. Marcus (Felix Mallard) accompanied her to the clinic, but then he fell into the throes of his substance abuse and depression by the end of Season 3, which saw him driven to rehab.
 Alongside Howey and Gentry, Diesel La Torraca returns as Austin Miller, Sara Waisglass returns as Marcus’ twin sister Maxine, Jennifer Robertson returns as the twins’ mom Ellen Baker, Raymond Ablack returns as Joe, Scott Porter returns as Mayor Paul Randolph, Katie Douglas returns as Abby, Chelsea Clark returns as Nora and Nathan Mitchell returns as Ginny’s father, Zion.
 RELATED: Jenny Daly’s Studio82 & Happy Accidents Developing Scripted YA Slate 
 Creator Sarah Lampert serves as co-showrunner and executive producer alongside Sarah Glinski. Executive producers include Jenny Daly, Jeff Tahler, Holly Hines, Daniel March (Dynamic Television), Lance Samuels and Daniel Iron (Blue Ice Pictures), David Monahan, Danielle Hoover and Ali Kinney.
 Newcomers for Season 4 include Ali Skovbye ( Firefly Lane ), Kataem O’Connor ( The Way Home ) and Sunny Mabrey ( Cape Fear , The Night Agent ).
